items.title: ⚡Flash Heard: GE Takes Blade Manufacturing In-House
items.summary: GE Aerospace on Tuesday said it will buy Consolidated Precision Products, a maker of blade and vanes for jet engines, for $11.75 billion.  CPP is one of the four major manufacturers of the blades and vanes that go into jet engines and power-generating natural gas turbines.  GE has been a customer of CPP for over 15 years, according to its announcement.
